data.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3 (supporting): ensures the Part B inference-gap firing mechanism connects to Phase 1 Step 2 re-entry in brainstorm SKILL.md so the replay test can actually verify re-entry

## Dependency
Must run AFTER d43f-bac7 (Part B scan implementation).

## What to Do
Inspect brainstorm SKILL.md and the scrutiny pipeline caller to verify that when Part B's Inference-Signal Scan fires (raises an inferred source as a gap), the orchestrator handles it by looping back to Phase 1 Step 2 with a Socratic question.

Search for: does brainstorm's scrutiny phase (Phase 3 or wherever epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md is called) handle a "gap finding for inferred input" by re-entering Phase 1? Look for:
- Phase 1 Step 2 re-entry logic
- Gap finding handling from scrutiny pipeline
- Inferred-source handling in the Phase 3/scrutiny call path

If the handler exists: document the handler location in a ticket comment.
If the handler is absent: add a brief instruction to brainstorm SKILL.md (or the relevant caller) that gap findings of type "inferred input source" from Part B cause re-entry to Phase 1 Step 2 with a targeted Socratic question per source.

This is a GREEN task — it either verifies existing behavior (no code change) or adds a small wiring instruction (1-3 lines in SKILL.md).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Handler verification complete (either found or added)
  Verify: grep -qE "inferred.*Phase 1|Phase 1.*inferred|Socratic.*inferred|inferred.*re-enter" plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md || (grep -q "inferred" plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md && echo "Found inferred handling")
- [ ] Ticket comment documenting handler location
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show <this-task-id> (check comments for handler location)
- [ ] All existing tests pass GREEN (no regressions)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-epic-scrutiny-pipeline.sh 2>&1 | grep FAIL (expect zero output)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Verify Phase 1 Step 2 re-entry handler exists in brainstorm for inference-gap signal
